items.title: Free Wheat Bouquet Checkered DXF Panel for Laser Cutting
items.description: A fine checkered grid fills the border and corners, punctuated by simple daisy flowers, while a detailed wheat and floral bouquet rises from the base of the panel. The mix of a plain grid texture with a naturalistic bouquet gives this design a harvest-themed, rustic character.
